# Microkeebs

> Custom mechanical keyboard builds, sound tests, and rankings, covering MX and electro-capacitive keyboards.

## Site

- [Keyboard builds and sound tests](https://microkeebs.micr.dev/): Browse Microkeebs builds and watch their sound tests.
- [Keyboard rankings](https://microkeebs.micr.dev/#/rankings): Compare ranked keyboards featured by Microkeebs.
- [Contact](https://microkeebs.micr.dev/#/contact): Find the site's contact options.

## Social

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@microkeebs): Watch Microkeebs keyboard sound tests and build videos.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/microkeebs/): View Microkeebs keyboard photos and short-form posts.
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@microkeebs): Watch short Microkeebs keyboard videos.
- [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/user/Microkeebs/): View the Microkeebs Reddit profile.

## Key Facts

- Microkeebs covers custom mechanical keyboard builds and sound tests.
- The collection includes MX and electro-capacitive keyboards.
